description: This file defines a ContentProvider named DataProvider for managing URLs of images and their associated metadata in an Android application. It includes database schema creation, querying, inserting, bulk inserting, and updating operations for tables related to picture URLs and their modification dates.

classes.name: DataProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that manages URL data for pictures and their update timestamps, utilizing an internal SQLite database.

classes.name: DataProvider.DataProviderHelper
classes.description: An inner class extending SQLiteOpenHelper, responsible for creating, upgrading, and downgrading the provider's SQLite database.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database helper to release resources.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider by creating a new database helper instance.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles querying the database based on the URI, returning cursors for specified tables.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given URI.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the specified table, primarily for the URL date table.

methods.name: bulkInsert
methods.description: Performs bulk insertion of multiple rows into tables with transaction support.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Unsupported operation; throws exception if called.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates rows in the date table based on the selection criteria.
